description: This Java abstract class defines a base for artifact information objects within the OFBiz web tools framework. It provides common properties and methods such as comparison, equality, hashing, and string representation, along with abstract methods for retrieving display and location details that subclasses must implement.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for artifact information representation, providing comparison, equality, and display logic, requiring subclasses to implement specific data retrieval methods.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this artifact info with another based on their string representation.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another object is equal to this artifact info, based on string representation.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the display name of the artifact.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the display type of the artifact.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the URL location of the artifact.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the type of the artifact.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the unique identifier of the artifact.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the string representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string combining display type and name, caching the result.
